request.what: Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for Cardano hardware-wallet support, compatibility, tooling, release support, developer support, supporting libraries, cardano-hw-cli, and vendor-required audit work.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for hardware wallet maintenance and compatibility assurance and 38,183 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The work is framed as 12 months of continuity maintenance for an already-proven Cardano hardware-wallet access layer rather than a new wallet product.
The proposer says continuous maintenance is needed because Cardano, Ledger, or Trezor changes could otherwise break secure access for users and integrations.

The proposed scope is limited to hardware-wallet compatibility, tooling, vendor-required assurance, supporting libraries, release support, and developer support, and the document says it does not duplicate broader core-node, ledger, or general infrastructure maintenance budgets.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting records, documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states that the requested amount did not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, and links the referenced NCL governance action.
The withdrawn funds are to be administered through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract using listed stake and payment addresses.
The document says oversight will involve Intersect, technically capable third parties, an Oversight Committee, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls.

The Oversight Committee is stated to consist of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl, with defined multi-party authorization thresholds for funding, disbursement, pause/resume, sweep, and reorganize actions.

The proposal discloses prior treasury or Catalyst funding related to hardware wallets, Ledger app work, Plutus enhancement, Ledger Live integration, message signing, security, token, and CTF projects through a list of links.

summary: The document requests 1,310,960 ada for 2026 continuity maintenance of Cardano hardware-wallet compatibility and related tooling, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor, with referenced Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, smart-contract treasury administration, oversight controls, and prior funding disclosures.
